examples.en: He can't endure being defeated.
examples.zh: 他无法忍受失败。

examples.en: The torn flag has endured as a symbol of freedom.
examples.zh: 这面破旗一直作为自由的象征存在着。

examples.en: The soldiers were enfeebled by lack of nutrition.
examples.zh: 士兵们因营养不足而变得虚弱。

examples.en: The place engendered immediate feelings of friendship and belonging.
examples.zh: 这个地方立即让人产生了亲切感和归属感。

examples.en: The issue engendered controversy.
examples.zh: 这个问题引发了争议。

examples.en: As the business grew, it totally engrossed him.
examples.zh: 随着业务扩大，他全身心投入其中。

meanings: 改善（价值、品质或吸引力）

examples.en: The runner says he's never used steroids to enhance his performance.
examples.zh: 这名跑步运动员说，自己从未使用类固醇提高成绩。

examples.en: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
examples.zh: 这是一个提升公司声誉的机会。

examples.en: Even after years he still remains an enigma to me.
examples.zh: 多年过去了，他对我而言仍是个谜。

examples.en: The code enjoined members to trade fairly.
examples.zh: 该守则要求成员公平交易。

examples.en: She didn't enlighten him about her background.
examples.zh: 她没有告诉他自己的背景。

examples.en: In a strange way she seemed ennobled by her grief.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是，悲痛似乎使她更高尚了。

examples.en: The full enormity of the crime has not yet been revealed.
examples.zh: 这起罪行的极端邪恶程度尚未被完全揭露。

examples.en: People are still coming to terms with the enormity of the disaster.
examples.zh: 人们仍在努力接受这场灾难的巨大影响。

examples.en: He enquired her name.
examples.zh: 他询问了她的名字。

examples.en: She enquired as to your whereabouts.
examples.zh: 她打听了你的下落。

examples.en: A committee was appointed to enquire into the allegations.
examples.zh: 一个委员会受命调查这些指控。

examples.en: These rights are enshrined in the country's constitution.
examples.zh: 这些权利庄严地载入了该国宪法。

examples.en: An argument ensued.
examples.zh: 随后发生了一场争执。

examples.en: The riot police swooped in and chaos ensued.
examples.zh: 防暴警察突然冲了进来，随后发生了混乱。

examples.en: The job entails a lot of hard work.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要付出大量辛劳。

examples.en: The bird had become entangled in the wire netting.
examples.zh: 那只鸟被铁丝网缠住了。

examples.en: He became entangled in a series of conflicts with the management.
examples.zh: 他卷入了与管理层的一系列冲突。

meanings: 主动积极且敢于行动的

examples.en: One enterprising farmer opened up his field as a car park and charged people £10 to park there.
examples.zh: 一位有进取心的农民将田地开放为停车场，每辆车收费十英镑。

examples.en: The children listened enthralled as the storyteller unfolded her tale.
examples.zh: 讲故事的人展开故事时，孩子们听得入了迷。

examples.en: He was not enticed into parting with his cash.
examples.zh: 他没有受到诱惑而掏出钱来。

examples.en: The bargain prices are expected to entice customers away from other stores.
examples.zh: 预计低廉的价格将把顾客从其他商店吸引过来。

examples.en: A separate entrance leads to the garden.
examples.zh: 一个独立的入口通向花园。

examples.en: They were refused entrance to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 他们被拒绝进入展览。

examples.en: I was entranced by the bird’s beauty.
examples.zh: 鸟儿的美丽使我着迷。

examples.en: She entreated him not to go.
examples.zh: 她恳求他不要走。

examples.en: I can't envisage her coping with this job.
examples.zh: 我无法想象她能应付这份工作。

examples.en: What level of profit do you envisage?
examples.zh: 你预期能达到什么利润水平？

examples.en: It is a critic’s job to follow every ephemeral fashion.
examples.zh: 评论家的工作就是关注每一种转瞬即逝的潮流。

examples.en: An epidemic of measles broke out, and over 200 children died.
examples.zh: 麻疹疫情暴发，二百多名儿童死亡。

examples.en: A recent report describes an epidemic of crime in the inner cities.
examples.zh: 最近的一份报告描述了市中心地区犯罪的迅速蔓延。

examples.en: Car theft is now reaching epidemic proportions.
examples.zh: 汽车盗窃现已蔓延到泛滥的程度。

examples.en: Fortinbras speaks the epilogue in Shakespeare’s ‘Hamlet’.
examples.zh: 福丁布拉斯在莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》中致终场辞。

examples.en: The death of the emperor marked the end of an epoch in the country's history.
examples.zh: 皇帝的去世标志着该国历史上一个时代的结束。

examples.en: She accepted the prospect of her operation with equanimity.
examples.zh: 她平静地接受了即将接受手术这一前景。

examples.en: We have achieved an equilibrium in the economy.
examples.zh: 我们已实现经济平衡。

examples.en: He sat down to try and recover his equilibrium.
examples.zh: 他坐下来，试图恢复平静。

examples.en: We are committed to supporting a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion.
examples.zh: 我们致力于支持多元、公平和包容的文化。

examples.en: He plans to raise the company’s return on equity to 15%.
examples.zh: 他计划将公司的股本回报率提高到百分之十五。

examples.en: She gave an equivocal answer, typical of a politician.
examples.zh: 她给了个模棱两可的回答，很像政治人物的作风。

examples.en: The experiments produced equivocal results.
examples.zh: 这些实验得出的结果不明确。

examples.en: Diphtheria has been virtually eradicated in the United States.
examples.zh: 白喉在美国已几乎被根除。

examples.en: We are determined to eradicate racism from our sport.
examples.zh: 我们决心从这项运动中彻底消除种族主义。

examples.en: The cliff face has been steadily eroded by the sea.
examples.zh: 海水一直在侵蚀这面峭壁。

examples.en: Her confidence has been slowly eroded by repeated failures.
examples.zh: 一再的失败慢慢削弱了她的信心。

meanings: 逐渐削弱（erode 的过去式及过去分词）

examples.en: The electricity supply here is quite erratic.
examples.zh: 这里的供电很不稳定。

examples.en: He was a well-respected and erudite scholar.
examples.zh: 他是位备受尊敬的博学学者。

examples.en: She could turn any conversation into an erudite discussion.
examples.zh: 她能将任何谈话变成学识渊博的讨论。

examples.en: He had eschewed politics in favour of a life practising law.
examples.zh: 他有意远离政治，选择以从事法律工作为生。

examples.en: Some of the commercial activities were a cover for espionage.
examples.zh: 某些商业活动是间谍活动的掩护。

examples.en: She may call it research; I call it industrial espionage.
examples.zh: 她可以把这叫作研究；我把这叫作工业间谍活动。

examples.en: They espoused the notion of equal opportunity for all in education.
examples.zh: 他们支持所有人在教育中享有平等机会的理念。

examples.en: Over the years, he has earned our affection and esteem.
examples.zh: 多年来，他赢得了我们的喜爱与尊敬。

examples.en: Many of these qualities are esteemed by managers.
examples.zh: 管理者珍视这些品质中的许多项。

examples.en: She was esteemed the perfect novelist.
examples.zh: 人们认为她是完美的小说家。

examples.en: I would never doubt the worthy intentions of that estimable gentleman.
examples.zh: 我绝不会怀疑那位可敬绅士的善意。

meanings: 江海交汇处（estuary 的复数）

examples.en: A security number had been etched on the car window as a protection against theft.
examples.zh: 车窗上蚀刻了一个安全号码，以防车辆被盗。

examples.en: It would have been more ethical for him to resign.
examples.zh: 如果他辞职，会更符合道德。

examples.en: Is it ethical to keep animals in zoos?
examples.zh: 将动物关在动物园里合乎道德吗？

meanings: 群体或文化的精神特质

examples.en: Teaching was central to his ethos.
examples.zh: 教学在他的价值观中居于核心地位。

examples.en: He was eulogized as a hero.
examples.zh: 他被赞颂为英雄。

meanings: 强烈的愉快或兴奋感，欣快感

examples.en: I was in a state of euphoria all day.
examples.zh: 我一整天都处于极度兴奋之中。

examples.en: Talk is evanescent, writing leaves footprints.
examples.zh: 话语转瞬即逝，文字则留下足迹。

meanings: （某一事业或观念的）热心倡导者

examples.en: I've always been an evangelist for new technology.
examples.zh: 我一向是新技术的热心倡导者。

meanings: 含糊其辞以避开问题的

examples.en: The pilot had to take evasive action to avoid a mid-air collision.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不采取规避动作，以免发生空中相撞。

examples.en: Tessa was evasive about why she had not been at home that night.
examples.zh: 苔莎对于那晚不在家的原因含糊其辞。

examples.en: He had an even-handed approach to the negotiations.
examples.zh: 他以不偏不倚的态度进行谈判。

examples.en: She evinced little enthusiasm for the outdoor life.
examples.zh: 她对户外生活几乎没表现出热情。

examples.en: He evinced a strong desire to be reconciled with his family.
examples.zh: 他表现出与家人和好的强烈愿望。

meanings: 剥夺核心内容或力量，使空洞无力

examples.en: The amendments passed in Congress completely eviscerated the Affordable Care Act.
examples.zh: 国会通过的修正案完全掏空了《平价医疗法案》的实质内容。

examples.en: Her new book is wonderfully evocative of village life.
examples.zh: 她的新书极其生动地唤起人们对乡村生活的联想。

examples.en: His aggressive reaction only exacerbated the situation.
examples.zh: 他激烈的反应只让情况更糟。

examples.en: This means that the technocrats must have bad effects; i.e., they must have “exacerbated” or “worsened” the country’s problems.
examples.zh: 这意味着这些技术官僚必定造成了不良影响；也就是说，他们必定使这个国家的问题“加剧”或“恶化”了。

source.locator: PDF 第 10 页（印刷页 10），Sentence Equivalence，Sample Question 2，Explanation 第 2 句；直接引用解析原句，没有补写题干空格

examples.en: He was an exacting man to work for.
examples.zh: 在他手下工作要求很严格。

examples.en: She was exalted as a pillar of the community.
examples.zh: 她被赞誉为社区的支柱。

examples.en: His son was exalted to a high position in the government through family connections.
examples.zh: 他的儿子凭借家族关系被提拔到政府高位。

examples.en: He shook his head in exasperation.
examples.zh: 他恼怒地摇了摇头。

examples.en: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
examples.zh: 只有在特殊情况下，这个期限才会延长。

examples.en: At the age of five he showed exceptional talent as a musician.
examples.zh: 五岁时，他就展现出非凡的音乐才能。

examples.en: The amounts she borrowed were not excessive.
examples.zh: 她借的钱并不过多。

examples.en: Excessive eating increases the risk of heart failure.
examples.zh: 过度进食会增加心力衰竭的风险。

examples.en: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.
examples.zh: 这家酒店享有海滩的专用权。

examples.en: Until 1994, the South African government was racially exclusive.
examples.zh: 直到一九九四年，南非政府仍在种族上具有排他性。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: He belongs to an exclusive club.
examples.zh: 他属于一家限制准入的高档俱乐部。

examples.en: The paper printed a world exclusive on the presidential scandal.
examples.zh: 这家报纸刊登了关于总统丑闻的全球独家报道。

examples.en: The defendant was able to exculpate himself from liability.
examples.zh: 被告得以证明自己无需承担责任。

examples.en: Her behaviour was exemplary.
examples.zh: 她的行为堪称楷模。

examples.en: Some students are exempt from certain exams.
examples.zh: 一些学生可以免考某些科目。

examples.en: Charities were exempted from paying the tax.
examples.zh: 慈善机构获准免缴这项税。

examples.en: He exerted all his authority to make them accept the plan.
examples.zh: 他运用全部权威使他们接受了计划。

examples.en: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
examples.zh: 他要想成功，就必须努力。

examples.en: He sat back and exhaled deeply.
examples.zh: 他往后一靠，深深呼出一口气。

meanings: 详尽无遗的，全面彻底的

examples.en: This list is not intended to be exhaustive.
examples.zh: 这份清单并不打算列尽所有内容。

examples.en: Speed had always exhilarated him.
examples.zh: 速度总使他兴奋。

examples.en: My first parachute jump was an exhilarating experience.
examples.zh: 我第一次跳伞是一次令人兴奋的经历。

examples.en: Young people often find danger rather exhilarating.
examples.zh: 年轻人常常觉得危险颇令人振奋。

examples.en: The political exigencies facing both leaders mean they must resume talks if violence is to be avoided.
examples.zh: 两位领导人面对的政治迫切要求意味着，要避免暴力就必须恢复谈判。

meanings: 特定情势下的迫切需要

examples.en: He put financial exigency before personal sentiment.
examples.zh: 他把迫切的财务需要置于个人感情之上。

examples.en: He returned after 40 years of exile.
examples.zh: 他在流亡四十年后回来了。

examples.en: He was exiled to the island of St Helena.
examples.zh: 他被放逐到圣赫勒拿岛。

examples.en: The police report exonerated Lewis from all charges of corruption.
examples.zh: 警方报告澄清了针对刘易斯的所有腐败指控。

examples.en: The president cannot be exonerated from responsibility for this problem.
examples.zh: 总统不能被免除对这个问题应负的责任。

examples.en: It’s a good hotel but the prices are exorbitant.
examples.zh: 酒店不错，但价格高得离谱。

examples.en: My family lived as expatriates in Hong Kong before I was born.
examples.zh: 我出生前，家人曾作为侨民居住在香港。

examples.en: There was an air of expectancy among the waiting crowd.
examples.zh: 等候的人群中弥漫着期待的气氛。

examples.en: We have developed rapid order processing to expedite deliveries to customers.
examples.zh: 我们建立了快速订单处理流程，以加快向客户送货。

examples.en: Hawkins had died on the same expedition a few weeks earlier.
examples.zh: 霍金斯几周前在同一次远征中去世了。

examples.en: Five members of Scott's expedition made it to the South Pole.
examples.zh: 斯科特考察队的五名成员抵达了南极。

examples.en: She was expelled from school at 15.
examples.zh: 她十五岁时被学校开除了。

examples.en: Expel all the air from your chest.
examples.zh: 将胸腔里的空气全部呼出。

examples.en: Soldiers in the ordinary ranks were considered expendable.
examples.zh: 普通士兵被认为是可以牺牲的。

meanings: 可以解释的，可以说明原因的

examples.en: His behaviour is only explicable in terms of (= because of) his recent illness.
examples.zh: 他的行为只能用他最近生病这件事来解释。

meanings: 明确直说的，清楚不含糊的

examples.en: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
examples.zh: 他十分明确地告诉了我去那里的路线。

examples.en: In the changed climate of the late 1970s, it was possible to include more sexually explicit material.
examples.zh: 在二十世纪七十年代末变化后的环境中，作品可以包含更多露骨的性描写。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: The report states explicitly that the system was to blame.
examples.zh: 报告明确指出，责任在于这个系统。

examples.en: The text does not explicitly mention him by name.
examples.zh: 文中没有直截了当地提到他的名字。

examples.en: She fully exploits the humour of her role in the play.
examples.zh: 她充分发挥了剧中角色的幽默感。

examples.en: The workers are ruthlessly exploited by their employers.
examples.zh: 工人们受到雇主的无情剥削。

meanings: 功绩、英勇或引人注目的行为

examples.en: He never liked to talk publicly about his wartime exploits.
examples.zh: 他从不喜欢公开谈论自己在战时的英勇事迹。

examples.en: The company maintains control over domestic natural gas exploration and exploitation.
examples.zh: 该公司保持着对国内天然气勘探与开发的控制。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: Starvation and poverty are the result of global economic exploitation, not lack of resources.
examples.zh: 饥饿和贫困是全球经济剥削的结果，而非资源匮乏所致。

examples.en: Immigrants are often vulnerable to exploitation.
examples.zh: 移民常常容易受到剥削。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

meanings: 为自身利益不公平利用他人的
认真劝诫，提出反对意见

examples.en: Details of his criminal activities were expunged from the file.
examples.zh: 他从事犯罪活动的详细情况被从档案中删除了。

examples.en: What happened just before the accident was expunged from his memory.
examples.zh: 事故发生前的事情已从他的记忆中被抹去。

meanings: 删去（文章中冒犯或不宜的内容）

examples.en: She gave an expurgated account of what had happened.
examples.zh: 她删去了不宜内容后叙述了事情的经过。

examples.en: Her wedding dress was absolutely exquisite.
examples.zh: 她的婚纱精美绝伦。

examples.en: The room was decorated in exquisite taste.
examples.zh: 房间的装饰体现出细腻高雅的品味。

examples.en: A limited number of documents from the period are still extant.
examples.zh: 那个时期的少量文献仍然存世。

examples.en: His knowledge of music is extensive.
examples.zh: 他的音乐知识很广博。

examples.en: The house has extensive grounds.
examples.zh: 这栋房子有大片庭院。

examples.en: Extensive research has been done into this disease.
examples.zh: 人们已经对这种疾病做了大量研究。

examples.en: She was exaggerating the true extent of the problem.
examples.zh: 她夸大了问题的实际程度。

examples.en: Sea ice varies considerably in extent and duration from year to year.
examples.zh: 海冰的分布范围和持续时间每年都有很大变化。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: The island is 300 square kilometres in extent.
examples.zh: 这座岛的面积为三百平方公里。

examples.en: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.
examples.zh: 许多外界影响都会作用于你的心境。

examples.en: The government is committed to reducing the country's external debt.
examples.zh: 政府致力于减少该国的外债。

meanings: 外表，外部特征（常用复数）

examples.en: Firefighters tried to extinguish the flames.
examples.zh: 消防员试图扑灭火焰。

examples.en: News of the bombing extinguished all hope of peace.
examples.zh: 爆炸的消息使和平的希望彻底破灭。

meanings: 彻底消灭（extirpate 的过去式及过去分词）

examples.en: We do not want any extraneous information on the page.
examples.zh: 我们不希望页面上有任何无关信息。

examples.en: Coughs and extraneous noises can be edited out.
examples.zh: 咳嗽声和多余的杂音可以被剪辑掉。

examples.en: He had managed to extricate himself from most of his official duties.
examples.zh: 他设法摆脱了大部分公务。

examples.en: They managed to extricate the pilot from the tangled control panel.
examples.zh: 他们设法从缠绕的控制面板中救出了飞行员。

examples.en: She's a real extrovert and loves to socialize and meet new people.
examples.zh: 她是个真正外向的人，喜欢社交和结识新人。

examples.en: He’s pretty extrovert when he’s on stage.
examples.zh: 他在舞台上相当外向。

examples.en: He is bold and extroverted.
examples.zh: 他大胆而外向。

examples.en: The fans were exultant at their team’s victory.
examples.zh: 球迷们为球队获胜欢欣鼓舞。

examples.en: That old factory is a real eyesore!
examples.zh: 那家旧工厂真碍眼！

examples.en: Stop being facetious; this is serious.
examples.zh: 别开玩笑了，这可是严肃的事。

examples.en: He had a faculty for seeing his own mistakes.
examples.zh: 他有发现自身错误的能力。

examples.en: She joined the faculty of the University of Maryland.
examples.zh: 她加入了马里兰大学的教师队伍。

meanings: 可能犯错的性质，易错性

examples.en: His voice faltered as he began his speech.
examples.zh: 他开始讲话时声音颤抖起来。

examples.en: Her courage never faltered.
examples.zh: 她的勇气从未动摇。

examples.en: The economy is beginning to falter.
examples.zh: 经济开始失去势头。

examples.en: The whole story sounds very far-fetched.
examples.zh: 整个故事听起来非常牵强。

examples.en: Jeans are always in fashion.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤始终流行。

examples.en: How could they behave in such a fashion?
examples.zh: 他们怎么能这样行事？

examples.en: She fashioned a pot from the clay.
examples.zh: 她用黏土制作了一个罐子。

examples.en: If she gets ill again, it could prove fatal.
examples.zh: 如果她再生病，可能会致命。

examples.en: Any delay would be fatal.
examples.zh: 任何延误都将造成灾难性后果。

examples.en: There is a mood of profound fatalism amongst party members.
examples.zh: 党员们中间弥漫着浓厚的宿命情绪。

examples.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
examples.zh: 这起事故应归咎于司机疲劳。

examples.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
examples.zh: 飞机的机翼出现了金属疲劳的迹象。

examples.en: High blood pressure fatigues the heart and damages blood vessels.
examples.zh: 高血压会使心脏疲劳，并损伤血管。

examples.en: Their arguments are completely fatuous.
examples.zh: 他们的论点完全愚蠢而空洞。

examples.en: Her piano-playing was faultless.
examples.zh: 她的钢琴演奏无可挑剔。

examples.en: Why is everybody fawning over him as if he were a national hero?
examples.zh: 为什么人人都像对待民族英雄一样奉承他？

examples.en: It's just not feasible to manage the business on a part-time basis.
examples.zh: 兼职经营这家企业根本不可行。

examples.en: The cooks were busy preparing the wedding feast.
examples.zh: 厨师们正忙着准备婚宴。

examples.en: We sat in the yard feasting on barbecued chicken and beer.
examples.zh: 我们坐在院子里尽情享用烤鸡和啤酒。

examples.en: That was no mean feat (= it was difficult to do).
examples.zh: 那可是一项非凡的壮举。

examples.en: The tunnel is a remarkable feat of engineering.
examples.zh: 这条隧道是一项了不起的工程成就。

meanings: 得体漂亮的，灵巧的（古旧）

examples.en: Fecundity declines rapidly after the age of 40.
examples.zh: 四十岁以后，生育能力迅速下降。

examples.en: The fecundity of her imagination remained undiminished throughout her life.
examples.zh: 她丰富的想象力终其一生都未曾减退。

examples.en: He looked feeble and confused.
examples.zh: 他看起来虚弱而迷茫。

examples.en: She made a feeble attempt to explain what had happened.
examples.zh: 她试图解释发生了什么，但解释苍白无力。

examples.en: ‘A present for me?’ she asked with feigned surprise.
examples.zh: “给我的礼物？”她装出惊讶的样子问。

examples.en: Trees were felled and floated downstream.
examples.zh: 树木被砍倒后顺流漂运。

examples.en: I love being up on the fells.
examples.zh: 我喜欢待在荒山上。

examples.en: The two women chatted over the garden fence.
examples.zh: 两个女人隔着花园篱笆聊天。

examples.en: His property is fenced with barbed wire.
examples.zh: 他的地产被铁丝网围了起来。

examples.en: The treatment has been tested on healthy fertile women under the age of 35.
examples.zh: 这种疗法已在三十五岁以下具有生育能力的健康女性身上试验过。

examples.en: The fall of the old regime provided fertile ground for opportunism.
examples.zh: 旧政权的垮台为机会主义提供了滋长的土壤。

examples.en: Anxiety and stress affect fertility in both men and women.
examples.zh: 焦虑和压力都会影响男性和女性的生育能力。

examples.en: Improve the soil fertility by adding compost.
examples.zh: 施加堆肥以提高土壤肥力。

examples.en: She kissed him with unusual fervour.
examples.zh: 她以异乎寻常的热情吻了他。

meanings: 怨恨加深，问题持续恶化

examples.en: If you don’t take the splinter out, it will fester.
examples.zh: 如果不取出那根刺，伤处就会化脓。

examples.en: She tried to inhale as little of the fetid air as possible.
examples.zh: 她尽量少吸入那恶臭的空气。

examples.en: A man lay fettered on the floor of the prison cell.
examples.zh: 一名男子被铐住，躺在牢房地板上。

examples.en: He felt fettered by petty rules and regulations.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己受到琐碎规章制度的束缚。

examples.en: They were at last freed from the fetters of ignorance.
examples.zh: 他们终于摆脱了无知的桎梏。

examples.en: The weather here is notoriously fickle.
examples.zh: 这里的天气出了名地变化无常。

examples.en: The account he gives of his childhood is fictitious.
examples.zh: 他所讲述的童年经历是虚构的。

examples.en: Police said the name John Haydon was fictitious, but the address given was genuine.
examples.zh: 警方说，约翰·海顿这个名字是假的，但所提供的地址是真实的。

examples.en: He delivered the sermon with fiery passion.
examples.zh: 他满怀炽热激情布道。

examples.en: He’s a big strong lad with a fiery temper.
examples.zh: 他是个身材高大健壮、脾气暴躁的小伙子。

examples.en: Are you telling me that these symptoms are just a figment of my imagination?
examples.zh: 你是在告诉我，这些症状只是我想象出来的东西吗？

examples.en: Maybe all happiness is a figment too.
examples.zh: 也许所有幸福也都是想象的产物。

examples.en: It's filthy in here!
examples.zh: 这里面脏死了！

examples.en: That's enough of your filthy language!
examples.zh: 别再说那些污言秽语了！

examples.en: Isn't it a filthy day?
examples.zh: 今天天气真糟糕，不是吗？

examples.en: It was a fitting finale to the day's events.
examples.zh: 这给当天的活动画上了恰当的句号。

examples.en: Nigel lacked his father’s elegance and finesse.
examples.zh: 奈杰尔缺乏他父亲那样的优雅和技巧。

examples.en: Only a few top players are able to finesse a victory in such a situation.
examples.zh: 只有少数顶尖选手能在这种情况下巧妙地赢得胜利。

meanings: 过分挑剔的，苛求细节的

examples.en: It's a very finicky job.
examples.zh: 这是一项需要精细处理的工作。

examples.en: The fiscal year begins in July.
examples.zh: 财政年度从七月开始。

meanings: 过分专注的，执着到难以转移注意力的

examples.en: He is fixated on things that remind him of his childhood.
examples.zh: 他过分迷恋那些能使他想起童年的东西。

examples.en: He’s got soft and flabby since he gave up running.
examples.zh: 自从不再跑步，他的身体变得松软了。

examples.en: He has a flair for languages.
examples.zh: 他有语言天赋。

examples.en: She dresses with real flair.
examples.zh: 她穿衣很有独特品位。

examples.en: He was flamboyant and temperamental on and off the stage.
examples.zh: 无论台上台下，他都张扬而喜怒无常。

examples.en: You're too intelligent to fall for his flattery.
examples.zh: 你那么聪明，不会受他的奉承蒙骗。

meanings: 因疼痛、惊吓等退缩，畏缩

examples.en: He flinched at the sight of the blood.
examples.zh: 他一看见血就畏缩了。

examples.en: Butterflies flitted from flower to flower.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶在花朵之间轻快地飞来飞去。

examples.en: She likes flouting convention and doing her own thing.
examples.zh: 她喜欢无视惯例，按自己的想法行事。

examples.en: Temperatures can fluctuate by as much as 10 degrees.
examples.zh: 气温的波动幅度可达十度。

examples.en: The doctor told him to drink plenty of fluids.
examples.zh: 医生嘱咐他多喝液体。

examples.en: The fluid political situation made investment impossible.
examples.zh: 变幻不定的政治局势使投资无法进行。

examples.en: She hated the flummery of public relations.
examples.zh: 她讨厌公关活动中虚浮的客套话。

examples.en: I was flummoxed by her question.
examples.zh: 她的问题把我弄糊涂了。

examples.en: His face flushed with anger.
examples.zh: 他气得脸涨红了。

examples.en: A pink flush spread over his cheeks.
examples.zh: 一抹粉红的红晕泛上他的双颊。

examples.en: Make sure the paving stones are flush with the lawn.
examples.zh: 确保铺路石与草坪齐平。

meanings: 性格或行为上的小缺点，小毛病
剑身近尖端的较弱部分

examples.en: We have to tolerate each other's little foibles.
examples.zh: 我们得容忍彼此的小毛病。

examples.en: It would be foolhardy to sail in weather like this.
examples.zh: 在这样的天气出海是愚勇之举。

examples.en: The female only leaves the young when she forages for food.
examples.zh: 雌性动物只有出去觅食时才会离开幼崽。

examples.en: The pigs are allowed to forage around in a large orchard.
examples.zh: 这些猪可以在一大片果园里四处觅食。

examples.en: Those on the front line make regular forays into occupied territory.
examples.zh: 前线人员经常突袭被占领区。

meanings: 冷峻吓人的，令人难以接近的

examples.en: The house looked dark and forbidding.
examples.zh: 那房子看上去阴暗而吓人。

examples.en: The figure in the foreground is the artist's mother.
examples.zh: 前景中的人物是画家的母亲。

examples.en: This issue is very much in the foreground.
examples.zh: 这个问题正处于十分显著的位置。

examples.en: The play foregrounds the relationship between father and daughter.
examples.zh: 这部戏突出表现了父女关系。

examples.en: We do not foresee any problems.
examples.zh: 我们预见不到任何问题。

examples.en: The extent of the damage could not have been foreseen.
examples.zh: 损失的程度事先无法预知。

examples.en: Try to anticipate what your child will do and forestall problems.
examples.zh: 试着预料孩子会做什么，提前防止问题发生。

examples.en: The witch foretold that she would marry a prince.
examples.zh: 女巫预言她将嫁给一位王子。

examples.en: None of us can foretell what lies ahead.
examples.zh: 我们谁也无法预先说出将来会发生什么。

meanings: 因违规等丧失或被没收

examples.en: If you cancel your flight, you will forfeit your deposit.
examples.zh: 如果取消航班，你将损失押金。

examples.en: This booking fee will be forfeit should you decide not to take up the accommodation.
examples.zh: 如果你决定不入住，这笔预订费将被没收。

examples.en: She forged a new career in the music business.
examples.zh: 她在音乐行业努力开创了新的事业。

examples.en: He's getting good at forging his mother's signature.
examples.zh: 他越来越擅长伪造母亲的签名。

examples.en: The company is forging ahead with its plans for expansion.
examples.zh: 这家公司正稳步推进扩张计划。

examples.en: In debate he was a formidable opponent.
examples.zh: 在辩论中，他是个强劲的对手。

examples.en: The two players together make a formidable combination.
examples.zh: 这两位选手联手形成了令人敬畏的组合。

examples.en: She has a formidable list of qualifications.
examples.zh: 她拥有一长串令人惊叹的资历。

examples.en: Traditional stories make use of formulaic expressions like ‘Once upon a time…’.
examples.zh: 传统故事会使用“很久以前……”这样的固定表达。

examples.en: He had made it clear to his wife that he would never forsake her.
examples.zh: 他已向妻子表明，自己绝不会抛弃她。

examples.en: The group forswears all worldly possessions.
examples.zh: 这个团体发誓放弃一切世俗财产。

meanings: 愿意透露情况的，坦率的

examples.en: Help was immediately forthcoming.
examples.zh: 援助立即就来了。

examples.en: She's never very forthcoming about her plans.
examples.zh: 她从不愿意透露太多自己的计划。

meanings: 直率坦诚的，直截了当的

examples.en: He spoke in a forthright manner but without anger.
examples.zh: 他说话直截了当，但没有怒气。

examples.en: The agreement between us is terminated forthwith.
examples.zh: 我们之间的协议即刻终止。

examples.en: His success depended on a fortuitous combination of circumstances.
examples.zh: 他的成功取决于各种情况的偶然结合。

meanings: 讨论公共问题的场所或媒介

examples.en: Television is now an important forum for political debate.
examples.zh: 电视如今是政治辩论的重要平台。

examples.en: It's a forum where new parents can exchange questions, advice and support.
examples.zh: 这是一个让新手父母交流问题、建议并相互支持的论坛。

examples.en: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.
examples.zh: 俱乐部旨在促进社区内部更好的关系。

examples.en: They have fostered over 60 children during the past ten years.
examples.zh: 过去十年里，他们寄养过六十多名儿童。

examples.en: The children were placed in foster care.
examples.zh: 这些孩子被安排接受寄养照料。

examples.en: Our boat foundered on a reef.
examples.zh: 我们的船撞上暗礁后沉没了。

examples.en: The project foundered after problems with funding.
examples.zh: 这个项目因资金问题而失败。

examples.en: How do you express 25% as a fraction?
examples.zh: 如何将百分之二十五表示为分数？

examples.en: She hesitated for the merest fraction of a second.
examples.zh: 她只犹豫了极短的一瞬间。

examples.en: He raised his voice a fraction.
examples.zh: 他稍微提高了嗓门。

examples.en: Children often get fractious and tearful when tired.
examples.zh: 孩子累了常会烦躁爱哭。

examples.en: The six fractious republics are demanding autonomy.
examples.zh: 这六个难以管束的共和国正在要求自治。

examples.en: Be careful not to drop it; it’s very fragile.
examples.zh: 当心别摔了；它很容易碎。

examples.en: The economy remains extremely fragile.
examples.zh: 经济仍然极其脆弱。

examples.en: There was an air of fragility about him.
examples.zh: 他身上有一种脆弱的气质。

examples.en: There was a fraught silence.
examples.zh: 出现了一阵令人紧张的沉默。

examples.en: The lowering of trade barriers has led to a free-for-all among exporters.
examples.zh: 贸易壁垒的降低使出口商陷入混乱竞争。

meanings: 人人可参与且缺乏约束的

examples.en: She tore the letter open in a frenzy.
examples.zh: 她狂乱地撕开了信。

examples.en: The speaker worked the crowd up into a frenzy.
examples.zh: 演讲者把人群的情绪煽动得极度激动。

examples.en: Nina remained on the fringe of the crowd.
examples.zh: 妮娜一直站在人群边缘。

examples.en: She stared at us from beneath her fringe.
examples.zh: 她从刘海下盯着我们。

examples.en: The beach was fringed by coconut palms.
examples.zh: 海滩边缘排列着椰子树。

examples.en: Sorry, I was being frivolous.
examples.zh: 对不起，我刚才不够严肃。

examples.en: Rudeness is just a front for her shyness.
examples.zh: 粗鲁只是她用来掩饰害羞的表象。

examples.en: The front of the car was badly damaged.
examples.zh: 车的前部损坏严重。

examples.en: He has always been hard-working and frugal.
examples.zh: 他一向勤劳节俭。

examples.en: The monks lead a frugal existence in their isolated monastery.
examples.zh: 僧侣们在与世隔绝的修道院里过着俭朴的生活。

examples.en: Our efforts to persuade her proved fruitless.
examples.zh: 我们劝说她的努力最终徒劳无功。

examples.en: We use fuel oil to heat our house.
examples.zh: 我们用燃料油给房子供暖。

examples.en: Uranium is used to fuel nuclear plants.
examples.zh: 铀被用来为核电站提供燃料。

examples.en: Higher salaries helped to fuel inflation.
examples.zh: 较高的工资助长了通货膨胀。

examples.en: He was always fulminating against interference from the government.
examples.zh: 他总是在怒斥政府的干涉。

examples.en: She fumbled in her pocket for a handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她在口袋里笨拙地摸索手帕。

examples.en: After a Pittsburgh fumble, Miami scored a touchdown.
examples.zh: 匹兹堡队掉球失误后，迈阿密队达阵得分。

meanings: 可等量等值替代的，可互换的

examples.en: Cryptocurrency, like other forms of money, is fungible.
examples.zh: 加密货币与其他形式的货币一样，可以等值互换。

examples.en: Their incompetence made me furious.
examples.zh: 他们的无能让我暴怒。

examples.en: Play was fast and furious in the opening minutes of the game.
examples.zh: 比赛开始的几分钟里，双方交锋快速而激烈。

meanings: 为……配备家具或所需物品

examples.en: She furnished him with the facts surrounding the case.
examples.zh: 她向他提供了案件的相关事实。

examples.en: Overseas investors furnished most of the capital for the project.
examples.zh: 海外投资者提供了这个项目的大部分资金。

examples.en: The room was furnished with antiques.
examples.zh: 房间里陈设着古董家具。

examples.en: He looked sly and furtive.
examples.zh: 他看起来狡猾而鬼祟。

examples.en: She cast a furtive glance over her shoulder.
examples.zh: 她偷偷地回头瞥了一眼。

examples.en: Her eyes blazed with fury.
examples.zh: 她的眼里燃烧着怒火。

examples.en: There was no shelter from the fury of the storm.
examples.zh: 没有地方可以躲避猛烈的暴风雨。

examples.en: The movie displayed a perfect fusion of image and sound.
examples.zh: 这部电影呈现了画面与声音的完美融合。

examples.en: She stroked the baby's fuzzy head.
examples.zh: 她抚摸着婴儿毛茸茸的脑袋。

examples.en: These photographs have come out fuzzy.
examples.zh: 这些照片拍出来模糊不清。

examples.en: Most people will politely look the other way if you commit some social gaffe.
examples.zh: 如果你在社交场合失礼，大多数人会礼貌地假装没看见。

examples.en: He made some real gaffes early in his career.
examples.zh: 他在职业生涯早期确实闹过一些失礼的笑话。

examples.en: The colourful flags added to the gaiety of the occasion.
examples.zh: 五彩旗帜增添了现场的欢快气氛。

examples.en: Nobody can gainsay his claims.
examples.zh: 没有人能否认他的主张。

examples.en: There is no gainsaying these facts.
examples.zh: 这些事实无可反驳。

examples.en: I almost admired the utter gall of the man.
examples.zh: 我几乎要佩服这个男人的厚颜无耻了。

examples.en: It galls me to have to apologize to her.
examples.zh: 不得不向她道歉让我感到恼火。

examples.en: She made a gallant attempt to hide her tears.
examples.zh: 她勇敢地试图掩饰泪水。

examples.en: The terrified horse galloped off.
examples.zh: 受惊的马飞奔而去。

examples.en: He rode off at a gallop.
examples.zh: 他骑马疾驰而去。

examples.en: The win galvanized the whole team.
examples.zh: 这场胜利激励了全队。

meanings: 混乱或歪曲的表达、过程

examples.en: It’s a little too garish for my taste.
examples.zh: 按我的品味，这有点过于俗艳。

examples.en: He was wearing a strange shapeless garment.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件奇怪而不成样子的衣服。

examples.en: Garnish the chicken with almonds.
examples.zh: 用杏仁给鸡肉配饰。

examples.en: Keep some olives to one side for garnish.
examples.zh: 留一些橄榄放在一旁作装饰配菜。

examples.en: The normally garrulous commentator had nothing to say.
examples.zh: 平日喋喋不休的评论员此刻无话可说。

examples.en: P+ is used to gauge the relative difficulty of a test question.
examples.zh: P+ 用于衡量一道试题的相对难度。

source.locator: PDF 第 7 页（印刷页 7），Evaluating Your Performance / Verbal Reasoning and Quantitative Reasoning Measures；P+ 在前文定义为答对比例

examples.en: Tomorrow's game against Arsenal will be a good gauge of their promotion chances.
examples.zh: 明天与阿森纳的比赛将很好地检验他们晋级的机会。

examples.en: What gauge of wire do we need?
examples.zh: 我们需要多大规格的电线？

examples.en: “Broadband” is a generic term for any high-speed connection to the Internet.
examples.zh: “宽带”是各种高速互联网连接的通称。

examples.en: The doctor offered me a choice of a branded or a generic drug.
examples.zh: 医生让我在品牌药和仿制药之间选择。

examples.en: The movie was pretty boring, with a generic storyline and emotionless characters.
examples.zh: 这部电影很无聊，情节平庸，人物毫无感情。

examples.en: Generics are usually less expensive than the original brand.
examples.zh: 无品牌药通常比原品牌药便宜。

examples.en: He was a kindly gentleman with white hair and a genial smile.
examples.zh: 他是位白发苍苍的和善绅士，带着亲切的微笑。

examples.en: He lived in genteel poverty (= trying to keep the style of a high social class, but with little money).
examples.zh: 他过着穷而仍讲究上流社会体面的生活。

examples.en: Her genteel accent irritated me.
examples.zh: 她那故作高雅的口音令我厌烦。

examples.en: Is the painting a genuine Picasso?
examples.zh: 这幅画是毕加索的真迹吗？

examples.en: He came across as a very genuine person.
examples.zh: 他给人的印象是个非常真诚的人。

examples.en: She is a genuine contender for the title.
examples.zh: 她确实是有实力争夺冠军的人。

examples.en: The report contains matters that are germane to the case.
examples.zh: 报告包含与此案有关的事项。

examples.en: An idea for a novel began to germinate in her mind.
examples.zh: 一个小说构思开始在她脑海中萌发。

examples.en: The bomb caused a gigantic explosion.
examples.zh: 这枚炸弹引起了巨大的爆炸。

examples.en: Now that she's a flight attendant, foreign travel has lost its glamour for her.
examples.zh: 如今她成了空乘，出国旅行对她已失去吸引力。

examples.en: Her long dark hair lent her a certain glamour.
examples.zh: 她长长的黑发给她增添了几分魅力。

examples.en: We could see the gleam of moonlight on the water.
examples.zh: 我们能看到水面上闪耀的月光。

examples.en: The moonlight gleamed on the water.
examples.zh: 月光在水面上闪烁。

meanings: 发出微光（gleam 的现在分词）

examples.en: Her eyes gleamed in the dark.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛在黑暗中闪着微光。

meanings: 一点点搜集、获取（信息等）

examples.en: These figures have been gleaned from a number of studies.
examples.zh: 这些数据是从多项研究中搜集来的。

meanings: 能言善辩却轻率或不真诚的

examples.en: He had assumed that his glib explanations would convince us.
examples.zh: 他以为那些轻率而圆滑的解释能说服我们。

examples.en: Having lost a large percentage of the vote, they were in no position to gloat.
examples.zh: 他们流失了很大比例的选票，没有资格得意扬扬。

examples.en: She was still gloating over her rival's disappointment.
examples.zh: 她仍在为对手的失望而幸灾乐祸。

meanings: 得意或幸灾乐祸的表现

examples.en: Caroline peered into the gloom of the hallway.
examples.zh: 卡罗琳向幽暗的走廊里凝视。

examples.en: He remained sunk in gloom for several days.
examples.zh: 他连续几天都沉浸在忧郁之中。

examples.en: It was a wet and gloomy day.
examples.zh: 那是一个潮湿阴暗的日子。

examples.en: We sat in gloomy silence.
examples.zh: 我们沮丧地默坐着。

meanings: 华丽而可能流于表面的

examples.en: Her hair looked soft and glossy.
examples.zh: 她的头发看起来柔软而有光泽。

examples.en: She works in one of the big fashion glossies.
examples.zh: 她在一家大型精美时尚杂志社工作。

meanings: 闷闷不乐的，郁郁寡欢的

examples.en: The couple looked distinctly glum.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇显得十分闷闷不乐。

examples.en: The players sat there with glum looks on their faces.
examples.zh: 球员们坐在那里，脸色阴沉。

examples.en: We admired the grandeur and simplicity of the Roman architecture.
examples.zh: 我们赞叹罗马建筑的宏伟与简洁。

examples.en: He has a sense of grandeur about him.
examples.zh: 他有一种高贵的气派。

examples.en: The grandiose scheme for a journey across the desert came to nothing.
examples.zh: 那项穿越沙漠的浮夸计划最终落空了。

examples.en: The grandiose scheme for a journey across the desert came to nothing.
examples.zh: 横穿沙漠的宏大计划最终落空了。

examples.en: Passers-by grappled with the man after the attack.
examples.zh: 袭击发生后，路人与那名男子扭打起来。

examples.en: The new government has yet to grapple with the problem of air pollution.
examples.zh: 新政府尚未着手努力解决空气污染问题。

examples.en: I was gratified by their invitation.
examples.zh: 他们的邀请令我十分满意。

examples.en: He only gave his consent in order to gratify her wishes.
examples.zh: 他同意只是为了满足她的愿望。

examples.en: It was a completely gratuitous insult which the singer’s agent was forced to apologize for.
examples.zh: 那是毫无道理的侮辱，歌手的经纪人被迫为此道歉。

examples.en: Many young people gravitate to the cities in search of work.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人为找工作而自然地流向城市。

examples.en: He collected the plates, which were covered with grease.
examples.zh: 他收起了那些沾满油脂的盘子。

examples.en: Her hands were covered with oil and grease.
examples.zh: 她的手上满是油和润滑脂。

examples.en: She’s very outgoing and gregarious.
examples.zh: 她非常外向，喜欢交际。

examples.en: The protest march created gridlock.
examples.zh: 抗议游行造成了交通完全堵塞。

examples.en: Congress is in gridlock.
examples.zh: 国会陷入僵局。

examples.en: She was overcome with grief when her husband died.
examples.zh: 丈夫去世时，她悲痛万分。

examples.en: It was a grief to them that they had no children.
examples.zh: 没有孩子是他们的一桩伤心事。

examples.en: He fell to the floor with a groan.
examples.zh: 他呻吟着倒在地板上。

examples.en: I don't have time to listen to your moans and groans.
examples.zh: 我没有时间听你唉声叹气地抱怨。

examples.en: He lay on the floor groaning.
examples.zh: 他躺在地板上呻吟。

examples.en: The family have three children and a gross income of £50 000.
examples.zh: 这家人有三个孩子，总收入为五万英镑。

examples.en: She earns £25 000 a year gross.
examples.zh: 她每年的税前总收入是两万五千英镑。

examples.en: The concert grossed a massive £2 million at the box office.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会的票房总收入高达两百万英镑。

examples.en: Press reports have been grossly exaggerated.
examples.zh: 新闻报道被严重夸大了。

examples.en: It was a grotesque figure with a snarling beast's head.
examples.zh: 那是一个长着龇牙兽头的怪诞形象。

examples.en: The story was too grotesque to believe.
examples.zh: 这个故事荒诞得令人无法相信。

examples.en: Our fears proved groundless.
examples.zh: 事实证明我们的恐惧毫无根据。

examples.en: He's a man with a grudge.
examples.zh: 他是个心怀怨恨的人。

meanings: 不情愿地给予或承认，吝惜

examples.en: I grudge having to pay so much tax.
examples.zh: 要交这么多税，我心里很不情愿。

examples.en: They kept grumbling that they were cold.
examples.zh: 他们不停地抱怨说冷。

examples.en: Thunder grumbled in the distance.
examples.zh: 远处雷声隆隆。

examples.en: My main grumble is about the lack of privacy.
examples.zh: 我主要抱怨的是缺乏隐私。

examples.en: Farmers should be guardians of the countryside.
examples.zh: 农民应当成为乡村的守护者。

examples.en: The court appoints a legal guardian for the child.
examples.zh: 法院为这个孩子指定了一名法定监护人。

examples.en: George was a man completely lacking in guile.
examples.zh: 乔治是个毫无奸诈之心的人。

examples.en: They were accused of overcharging gullible tourists.
examples.zh: 他们被控向轻信的游客收取过高费用。

examples.en: They waited for his habitual response.
examples.zh: 他们等着他一贯的反应。

meanings: 陈腐的，因滥用而缺乏新意的
过度美化人物的传记或文字

examples.en: He made a half-hearted attempt to justify himself.
examples.zh: 他敷衍地试着为自己辩解。

examples.en: The regime adopted the style which was to become its hallmark in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 该政权采用了后来在二十世纪六十年代成为其显著特征的风格。

examples.en: She walked towards him and then halted.
examples.zh: 她向他走去，然后停了下来。

examples.en: Work came to a halt when the machine broke down.
examples.zh: 机器故障时，工作停了下来。

examples.en: High winds hampered the rescue attempt.
examples.zh: 强风阻碍了救援行动。

meanings: 有盖大篮，洗衣篮或食品篮

examples.en: The mayor is currently hamstrung by a budget crisis.
examples.zh: 市长目前受到预算危机的严重限制。

examples.en: She's pulled a hamstring.
examples.zh: 她拉伤了膝后肌腱。

examples.en: In a job like this, lack of experience is no real handicap.
examples.zh: 对于这样的工作，缺乏经验算不上真正的障碍。

examples.en: He plays off a handicap of 5.
examples.zh: 他按五杆差点打球。

examples.en: Smaller parties are seriously handicapped by the electoral system.
examples.zh: 选举制度使较小的政党处于严重不利的地位。

examples.en: The government's approach to the problem was haphazard.
examples.zh: 政府处理这个问题的方法缺乏计划。

examples.en: The books had been piled on the shelves in a haphazard fashion.
examples.zh: 书被杂乱无章地堆放在架子上。

examples.en: He has complained of being harassed by the police.
examples.zh: 他抱怨自己受到警方骚扰。

examples.en: Our convoys are being continually harassed by enemy submarines.
examples.zh: 我们的运输船队不断受到敌方潜艇的袭扰。

examples.en: We must harness the skill and creativity of our workforce.
examples.zh: 我们必须利用员工的技能和创造力。

examples.en: We harnessed two ponies to the cart.
examples.zh: 我们给两匹小马套上挽具，让它们拉车。

examples.en: The sight of horses in harness hauling timber was common a hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 一百年前，套着挽具的马拖运木材是常见景象。

examples.en: Traditionally whales were hunted with harpoons.
examples.zh: 传统上，人们用鱼叉猎鲸。

examples.en: Thousands of whales have been harpooned in these waters.
examples.zh: 数千头鲸鱼在这片水域中遭到鱼叉捕杀。

examples.en: They remain harrowed by the eight weeks of bombing.
examples.zh: 那八周的轰炸仍使他们深受折磨。

examples.en: The punishment was harsh and unfair.
examples.zh: 这种惩罚严厉且不公平。

examples.en: He looked at me with intense hatred.
examples.zh: 他满怀强烈仇恨地看着我。

examples.en: He replied with haughty disdain.
examples.zh: 他带着傲慢的轻蔑作答。

examples.en: She threw him a look of haughty disdain.
examples.zh: 她朝他投去傲慢而轻蔑的一瞥。

examples.en: The memory of that day still haunts me.
examples.zh: 那天的记忆仍萦绕着我。

examples.en: A headless rider haunts the country lanes.
examples.zh: 一个无头骑士的鬼魂在乡间小路上出没。

examples.en: The pub is a favourite haunt of artists.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧是艺术家们爱去的地方。

examples.en: It would be hazardous to invest so much.
examples.zh: 投入这么多资金会很危险。

examples.en: They endured a hazardous journey through thickening fog.
examples.zh: 他们在越来越浓的雾中经历了一段危险的旅程。

examples.en: I was heartened by all the support I received.
examples.zh: 我得到的种种支持令我倍受鼓舞。

examples.en: Today was too hectic for me.
examples.zh: 今天忙得让我难以招架。

examples.en: They've got a hectic schedule planned.
examples.zh: 他们计划了一份紧张繁忙的日程。

meanings: 以快乐为人生主要目标的生活方式
主导群体的社会、文化或经济影响

examples.en: People ran helter-skelter. There were bodies on the ground and the injured were crying.
examples.zh: 人们慌乱地奔跑。地上躺着尸体，伤者正在哭喊。

examples.en: Henceforth, all staff will need to provide proof of identity before entering the building.
examples.zh: 从今以后，所有员工进入大楼前都须出示身份证明。

examples.en: Friday 31 July 1925 henceforth became known as ‘Red Friday’.
examples.zh: 一九二五年七月三十一日星期五从此被称为“红色星期五”。

examples.en: Have you had your hepatitis B vaccination?
examples.zh: 你接种过乙肝疫苗吗？

examples.en: I think of primroses as the heralds of spring.
examples.zh: 我把报春花看作春天的先驱。

examples.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
examples.zh: 这些会谈可能预示着和平新时代的到来。

examples.en: The report is being heralded as a blueprint for the future of transport.
examples.zh: 这份报告被热烈赞誉为未来交通的蓝图。

examples.en: There aren't many houses hereabouts.
examples.zh: 这附近房子不多。

meanings: 违背主流观点的异说或做法

examples.en: He was burned at the stake for heresy.
examples.zh: 他因异端信仰而被处以火刑。

examples.en: The idea is heresy to most employees of the firm.
examples.zh: 对该公司的大多数员工来说，这个想法是异端邪说。

meanings: 全盛期，最成功或最活跃的时期

examples.en: In its heyday, the company ran trains every fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 在全盛时期，这家公司每十五分钟就开出一班火车。

examples.en: I don't believe any of their motives are as high-minded as they pretend.
examples.zh: 我不相信他们的动机像他们装出的那样高尚。

examples.en: It's sometimes hard to live up to his high-minded religious ideals.
examples.zh: 有时很难践行他那些高尚的宗教理想。

meanings: 尤指纯为金钱效力的人

examples.en: The ceremony went off without a hitch.
examples.zh: 典礼顺利进行，没有出现任何小故障。

examples.en: She hitched the pony to the gate.
examples.zh: 她把小马系在大门上。

examples.en: We hitched a ride with a travelling salesman.
examples.zh: 我们搭了一位旅行推销员的便车。

examples.en: His hair was a hoary white.
examples.zh: 他的头发灰白了。

examples.en: The emergency call turned out to be a hoax.
examples.zh: 那个紧急求助电话原来是个恶作剧。

examples.en: He hoaxed us by sending a friend instead of coming himself. We’d never met him so we had no reason to think it wasn’t him.
examples.zh: 他自己没来，却派了一个朋友来骗我们。我们从未见过他，所以没有理由认为来的人不是他。

examples.en: Cultural homogeneity is created by education and the media.
examples.zh: 文化同质性是由教育和媒体塑造的。

examples.en: Old people are not a homogeneous group, as some people seem to think.
examples.zh: 老年人并不像某些人想象的那样是一个同质群体。

examples.en: The knife had been honed to razor sharpness.
examples.zh: 那把刀已磨得像剃刀一样锋利。

examples.en: She honed her debating skills at college.
examples.zh: 她在大学磨练了辩论技巧。

examples.en: She had been hoodwinked into buying a worthless necklace.
examples.zh: 她被骗着买了一条不值钱的项链。

examples.en: She was openly hostile towards her parents.
examples.zh: 她公然对父母抱有敌意。

examples.en: The speaker got a hostile reception from the audience.
examples.zh: 演讲者受到听众不友好的对待。

examples.en: I didn't want to humiliate her in front of her colleagues.
examples.zh: 我不想在她同事面前让她难堪。

examples.en: How could I humiliate myself like that?
examples.zh: 我怎么能那样自取其辱？

examples.en: Her first defeat was an early lesson in humility.
examples.zh: 第一次失败让她很早就懂得了谦逊。

examples.en: It was a story full of gentle humor.
examples.zh: 这是个充满温和幽默的故事。

examples.en: The remarks were made in good humor.
examples.zh: 这些话是在心情愉快时说的。

examples.en: She thought it best to humor them rather than get into an argument.
examples.zh: 她认为最好顺着他们，免得争吵起来。

examples.en: This is my husband, Steve.
examples.zh: 这是我丈夫，史蒂夫。

examples.en: Times are hard and we have to husband our resources.
examples.zh: 日子艰难，我们必须节约使用资源。

examples.en: Brown rice has not had the husks removed.
examples.zh: 糙米没有去除外壳。

examples.en: Husk the ears of corn and brush them with melted butter.
examples.zh: 剥去玉米棒的外皮，再刷上融化的黄油。

examples.en: He’s not usually given to hyperbole.
examples.zh: 他通常不爱用夸张的说法。

examples.en: The film is being promoted with all the usual hyperbole.
examples.zh: 这部电影正用惯常的种种夸大之词进行宣传。

examples.en: A note of hysteria crept into her voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音中渐渐透出歇斯底里的激动。

examples.en: The people were gripped by mass hysteria.
examples.zh: 人们陷入了集体性的失控恐慌。

meanings: 挑战传统权威或既定观念的

examples.en: She's still young and idealistic.
examples.zh: 她还年轻，满怀理想。

examples.en: The two pictures are similar, although not identical.
examples.zh: 这两幅图很相似，但并非完全相同。

examples.en: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.
examples.zh: 这就是我们去年住过的同一个房间。

meanings: 意识形态的坚定拥护者
符合语言习惯的，地道的

examples.en: She speaks fluent and idiomatic English.
examples.zh: 她讲一口流利地道的英语。

meanings: 个人特有的习性、癖好或特征

examples.en: Wearing a raincoat, even on a hot day, is one of her idiosyncrasies.
examples.zh: 即使在大热天也穿雨衣，是她的怪癖之一。

examples.en: The car has its little idiosyncrasies.
examples.zh: 这辆车有它自己的小特点。

examples.en: Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
examples.zh: 现在超过百分之十的劳动力处于失业闲置状态。

examples.en: It is idle to pretend that their marriage is a success.
examples.zh: 假装他们的婚姻很成功是徒劳的。

examples.en: They idled the days away, talking and watching television.
examples.zh: 他们聊天、看电视，把日子闲混过去。

examples.en: She left the car idling at the roadside.
examples.zh: 她让汽车停在路边空转。

examples.en: Gas ignites very easily.
examples.zh: 煤气很容易燃烧。

examples.en: His words ignited their anger.
examples.zh: 他的话激起了他们的愤怒。

examples.en: They fought a long battle against prejudice and ignorance.
examples.zh: 他们长期与偏见和无知作斗争。

examples.en: He showed a remarkable ignorance of the facts.
examples.zh: 他对这些事实的不了解程度令人惊讶。

examples.en: She was kept in ignorance of her husband's activities.
examples.zh: 她一直被蒙在鼓里，不知道丈夫的活动。

examples.en: Her remarks were ill-advised, to say the least.
examples.zh: 说得轻些，她的话也欠考虑。

examples.en: Floodlights illuminated the stadium.
examples.zh: 泛光灯照亮了体育场。

examples.en: This text illuminates the philosopher's early thinking.
examples.zh: 这篇文本阐明了那位哲学家的早期思想。

examples.en: The commentary was highly illuminating.
examples.zh: 这番评论极富启发性。

examples.en: We didn't find the examples he used particularly illuminating.
examples.zh: 我们觉得他所用的例子并不特别有助于理解。

examples.en: Any power he may seem to have is purely illusory.
examples.zh: 他看似拥有的任何权力都完全是虚幻的。

examples.en: He imbibed elements of oriental mysticism from the years he spent in India.
examples.zh: 在印度生活的那些年里，他吸收了一些东方神秘主义思想。

examples.en: Her voice was imbued with an unusual seriousness.
examples.zh: 她的声音带着异乎寻常的严肃意味。

examples.en: He was imbued with a desire for social justice.
examples.zh: 追求社会正义的愿望深深影响着他。

examples.en: Dolphins learn to imitate sounds very accurately and quickly.
examples.zh: 海豚能十分准确而迅速地学会模仿声音。

examples.en: Her style of painting has been imitated by other artists.
examples.zh: 她的绘画风格被其他艺术家仿效。

examples.en: The style is imitative of Basque architecture.
examples.zh: 这种风格模仿了巴斯克建筑。

examples.en: His work has been criticized for being imitative and shallow.
examples.zh: 他的作品被批评为缺乏独创性且肤浅。

examples.en: The cost is immaterial.
examples.zh: 费用无关紧要。

examples.en: These facts are immaterial to the problem.
examples.zh: 这些事实与这个问题无关。

examples.en: The benefits are immense.
examples.zh: 好处非常巨大。

examples.en: There is still an immense amount of work to be done.
examples.zh: 仍有大量工作要做。

meanings: 即将发生的、迫在眉睫的

examples.en: An attack seems imminent.
examples.zh: 袭击似乎即将发生。

meanings: 献祭，尤指以火烧死作为祭献

examples.en: He believed himself immortal.
examples.zh: 他相信自己不会死。

examples.en: In the poem, Satan vows revenge and immortal hate.
examples.zh: 诗中的撒旦发誓要复仇，并抱有永不消逝的仇恨。

examples.en: She is one of the Hollywood immortals.
examples.zh: 她是好莱坞名垂后世的人物之一。

examples.en: This decision should not be seen as immutable.
examples.zh: 不应把这项决定视为不可改变。

examples.en: His age impaired his chances of finding a new job.
examples.zh: 他的年龄损害了他找到新工作的机会。

examples.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
examples.zh: 即使只喝一杯酒，也可能削弱驾驶表现。

examples.en: The spice imparts an Indian flavour to the dish.
examples.zh: 这种香料为菜肴增添了印度风味。

examples.en: As chairperson, I must remain impartial.
examples.zh: 作为主席，我必须保持公正。

meanings: 使充满激情，激起强烈感情

examples.en: He made an impassioned plea for the rebels to lay down their arms.
examples.zh: 他热切地恳请叛军放下武器。

meanings: 不露感情的，面无表情的

examples.en: The two men remained impassive throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 这两名男子在整个审判过程中始终面无表情。

examples.en: The President was impeached by Congress for lying.
examples.zh: 总统因撒谎受到国会弹劾。

examples.en: Work on the building was impeded by severe weather.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气阻碍了大楼的施工。

examples.en: A number of practical difficulties impeded the process.
examples.zh: 许多实际困难妨碍了这一过程。

examples.en: In what ways did economic factors impede progress?
examples.zh: 经济因素在哪些方面拖慢了进展？

examples.en: They were all filled with a sense of impending doom.
examples.zh: 他们全都充满了灾难即将降临的感觉。

examples.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
examples.zh: 他们的行话让外行难以理解。

examples.en: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
examples.zh: 我们绝对必须在下周前完成。

examples.en: In ‘Go away!’ the verb is in the imperative.
examples.zh: 在“Go away!”中，动词使用的是祈使语气。

examples.en: You should write your report in an impersonal manner.
examples.zh: 你应该用不带个人感情的方式写报告。

examples.en: Let's keep the criticism general and impersonal.
examples.zh: 我们还是作一般性批评，不要针对个人。

examples.en: Business letters need not be formal and impersonal.
examples.zh: 商务信函不必显得拘谨而冷漠。

examples.en: She remained implacable (= she would not change her feelings and opinions).
examples.zh: 她始终不肯缓和，不愿改变自己的感情和看法。

examples.en: Her explanation is not implausible.
examples.zh: 她的解释并非难以置信。

examples.en: It was all highly implausible.
examples.zh: 这一切都显得极不合理。

examples.en: A new work programme for young people will be implemented.
examples.zh: 一个面向年轻人的新工作计划将付诸实施。

examples.en: Such initiatives may be costly or otherwise difficult to implement.
examples.zh: 实施这类举措可能成本高昂，或在其他方面存在困难。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: Make sure that all sharp implements, such as scythes, have covers.
examples.zh: 确保所有锋利的工具，比如长柄大镰刀，都套上护套。

examples.en: Senior officials were implicated in the scandal.
examples.zh: 高级官员被牵涉进了这起丑闻。

examples.en: The results implicate poor hygiene as one cause of the outbreak.
examples.zh: 结果表明，卫生不良是疫情暴发的一个原因。

examples.en: We also have questions that get at inferences and implications, what the passage says implicitly.
examples.zh: 我们也有考查推断和隐含意义的问题，也就是考查文章含蓄表达了什么。

source.locator: 官方逐字稿：阅读理解中的推断和隐含意义

examples.en: It reinforces, implicitly or explicitly, the idea that money is all-important.
examples.zh: 这会以含蓄或明确的方式强化金钱至上的观念。

examples.en: I trust John implicitly.
examples.zh: 我完全信任约翰。

examples.en: It would have been impolitic to refuse his offer.
examples.zh: 拒绝他的提议本会是不明智的。

examples.en: The report calls for a ban on the import of hazardous waste.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁禁止进口危险废物。

examples.en: It is difficult to understand the full import of this statement.
examples.zh: 很难完全理解这段声明的含义。

examples.en: The country has to import most of its raw materials.
examples.zh: 这个国家必须进口大部分原材料。

examples.en: She didn't want to impose her values on her family.
examples.zh: 她不想把自己的价值观强加给家人。

examples.en: Everyone imposes on Dave's good nature.
examples.zh: 每个人都利用戴夫的好脾气占便宜。

examples.en: The car was impounded by the police after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后，警方扣押了这辆车。

examples.en: It was totally impractical to think that we could finish the job in two months.
examples.zh: 认为我们能在两个月内完成工作，完全不切实际。

examples.en: He was a wonderful companion but hopelessly impractical.
examples.zh: 他是个极好的伙伴，却完全不善于处理实际事务。

examples.en: There is considerable imprecision in the terminology used.
examples.zh: 所使用的术语相当不精确。

examples.en: The team built up an impregnable 5–1 lead.
examples.zh: 这支队伍建立了五比一的稳固领先优势。

examples.en: He improvised on the melody.
examples.zh: 他围绕这段旋律即兴演奏。

examples.en: We improvised some shelves out of planks of wood and bricks.
examples.zh: 我们用木板和砖头临时拼了些架子。

meanings: 质疑、攻击（真实性、正直、动机等）

examples.en: There were no real grounds for impugning the decision.
examples.zh: 没有真正的理由质疑这项决定。

examples.en: You're so impulsive!
examples.zh: 你真冲动！

examples.en: He told me not to be impulsive but to think it over.
examples.zh: 他告诉我不要凭一时冲动行事，而要仔细考虑。

examples.en: They continue to break the law with impunity.
examples.zh: 他们继续违法，却不受惩罚。

examples.en: The accident was the result of a moment's inattention.
examples.zh: 这起事故是一时疏忽造成的。

examples.en: He will be inaugurated (as) president in January.
examples.zh: 他将在一月宣誓就任总统。

examples.en: The moon landing inaugurated a new era in space exploration.
examples.zh: 登月开创了太空探索的新纪元。

examples.en: There is no incentive for people to save fuel.
examples.zh: 人们没有节约燃料的动力。

meanings: 取得高级学位（特定大学旧用法）

examples.en: The club has grown rapidly since its inception in 2007.
examples.zh: 这个俱乐部自二〇〇七年成立以来发展迅速。

examples.en: He had a clear, incisive mind.
examples.zh: 他的头脑清晰而敏锐。

examples.en: Young people incline towards individualistic behaviour.
examples.zh: 年轻人倾向于个人主义的行为方式。

examples.en: The land inclined gently towards the shore.
examples.zh: 地面缓缓向海岸倾斜。

examples.en: The party must adopt more inclusive strategies and a broader vision.
examples.zh: 该党必须采取更具包容性的策略和更宽广的视野。

examples.en: The castle is open daily from May to October inclusive.
examples.zh: 城堡从五月到十月每天开放，包含这两个月在内。

examples.en: The hours of the job are incompatible with family life.
examples.zh: 这份工作的时间安排与家庭生活不相容。

examples.en: These two objectives are mutually incompatible.
examples.zh: 这两个目标彼此无法并存。

examples.en: New computer software is often incompatible with older computers.
examples.zh: 新计算机软件往往与旧电脑不兼容。

examples.en: The governor was accused of being incompetent to lead.
examples.zh: 州长被指责没有能力领导。

examples.en: The prime minister was attacked as incompetent to lead.
examples.zh: 首相受到指责，被认为无力领导。

examples.en: He’s a hopeless incompetent.
examples.zh: 他是个无可救药的不称职者。

examples.en: She was struck by the incongruity of the situation.
examples.zh: 这种情形的不协调令她十分惊讶。

examples.en: The two of them made an incongruous couple.
examples.zh: 他们俩是很不相称的一对。

examples.en: Such traditional methods seem incongruous in our technical age.
examples.zh: 在我们的科技时代，这样的传统方法显得不合时宜。

examples.en: The speech was full of inconsequential details.
examples.zh: 这场演讲充满了无关紧要的细节。

examples.en: Many of your suggestions have been incorporated in the plan.
examples.zh: 你的许多建议已被纳入计划。

examples.en: Research results are incorporated in educational materials.
examples.zh: 研究成果被融入教学材料中。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: The company was incorporated in 2008.
examples.zh: 这家公司于二〇〇八年注册成立。

meanings: 表面形成的硬层或沉积物

examples.en: It was incumbent on them to attend.
examples.zh: 他们有义务出席。

examples.en: She had incurred the wrath of her father by marrying without his consent.
examples.zh: 她未经父亲同意就结婚，惹得父亲大怒。

examples.en: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.
examples.zh: 如果超过透支限额，你就可能需要承担银行手续费。

examples.en: Government troops made an incursion into territory held by the rebels.
examples.zh: 政府军突入了叛军控制的领土。

examples.en: The defeated nations were forced to pay an indemnity of $800 million.
examples.zh: 战败国被迫支付八亿美元赔偿金。

examples.en: The senator was indicted for murder.
examples.zh: 这名参议员因谋杀罪受到正式起诉。

examples.en: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
examples.zh: 袋鼠原产于澳大利亚。

examples.en: She campaigns for indigenous rights.
examples.zh: 她为原住民权利开展运动。

meanings: 因不公、侮辱或错误而愤慨的

examples.en: She was very indignant at the way she had been treated.
examples.zh: 她对自己受到的待遇非常愤慨。

examples.en: Doctors have been criticized for their indiscriminate use of antibiotics.
examples.zh: 医生们因不加区别地使用抗生素而受到批评。

examples.en: She's always been indiscriminate in her choice of friends.
examples.zh: 她选择朋友一向不加挑选。

examples.en: Nothing would induce me to take the job.
examples.zh: 没有什么能促使我接受那份工作。

examples.en: Hearing loss is often induced by exposure to loud noise.
examples.zh: 听力丧失常由接触强噪声引起。

examples.en: From the experimental evidence, one infers or induces the hypothesis.
examples.zh: 人们从实验证据中推断或归纳出假设。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: She did not believe in indulging the children with presents.
examples.zh: 她不赞成用礼物纵容孩子。

examples.en: The inheritance enabled him to indulge his passion for art.
examples.zh: 这笔遗产使他能够满足对艺术的热爱。

examples.en: He lay inert with half-closed eyes.
examples.zh: 他半闭着眼睛，一动不动地躺着。

examples.en: The president has to operate within an inert political system.
examples.zh: 总统必须在一个缺乏活力的政治体制内运作。

examples.en: A rise in interest rates seems inevitable.
examples.zh: 利率上涨似乎不可避免。

examples.en: It was inevitable that there would be job losses.
examples.zh: 裁员是不可避免的。

examples.en: Knowledge and economic power have become inextricable.
examples.zh: 知识与经济实力已变得密不可分。

examples.en: Europe's foreign policy is inextricably linked with that of the US.
examples.zh: 欧洲的外交政策与美国的外交政策密不可分。

examples.en: She had become inextricably involved in the campaign.
examples.zh: 她已经卷入这场运动，难以脱身。

meanings: 绝不出错的性质，绝对可靠性

examples.en: Modern music is often considered inferior to that of the past.
examples.zh: 现代音乐常被认为不如过去的音乐。

examples.en: His comments have inflamed teachers all over the country.
examples.zh: 他的言论激怒了全国的教师。

examples.en: The latest revelations are set to inflame public opinion still further.
examples.zh: 最新披露的情况势必进一步煽动公众情绪。

examples.en: The doctor's notes recorded inflammation of the ear.
examples.zh: 医生的记录上记着耳部发炎。

meanings: 煽动性的，容易激怒人的

examples.en: Inflate your life jacket by pulling sharply on the cord.
examples.zh: 用力拉绳子，让救生衣充气。

examples.en: The media have grossly inflated the significance of this meeting.
examples.zh: 媒体极大地夸大了这次会议的重要性。

examples.en: The talk was both informative and entertaining.
examples.zh: 这场讲话既增长知识又有趣。

examples.en: Findings suggest that while television is more informative than the press, it is less persuasive.
examples.zh: 研究结果表明，电视提供的信息比报刊更多，却更缺乏说服力。

examples.en: His plots are always very ingenious.
examples.zh: 他设计的情节总是很巧妙。

examples.en: She's very ingenious when it comes to finding excuses.
examples.zh: 她在找借口方面很有独创性。

meanings: 急切或贪婪地吃下、吸收

examples.en: She closed her eyes and inhaled deeply.
examples.zh: 她闭上眼睛，深深吸了一口气。

examples.en: Violence is inherent in our society.
examples.zh: 暴力是我们社会固有的问题。

examples.en: He believed there was no inherent contradiction between religion and science.
examples.zh: 他认为宗教与科学之间并不存在内在矛盾。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: She inherited a fortune from her father.
examples.zh: 她从父亲那里继承了一大笔财产。

examples.en: He has inherited his mother's patience.
examples.zh: 他继承了母亲的耐心。

examples.en: I inherited a number of problems from my predecessor.
examples.zh: 我从前任那里接手了一堆问题。

examples.en: Alcohol significantly inhibits the action of the drug.
examples.zh: 酒精会显著抑制这种药物的作用。

examples.en: The managing director's presence inhibited them from airing their problems.
examples.zh: 总经理在场，使他们不敢说出自己的问题。

examples.en: He never lost his innate sense of fun.
examples.zh: 他从未失去天生的幽默趣味。

examples.en: Many children seem to have an innate sense of justice.
examples.zh: 许多孩子似乎具有与生俱来的正义感。

examples.en: There will be a prize for the most innovative design.
examples.zh: 最具创新性的设计将获奖。

examples.en: The public seems to have an insatiable appetite for celebrity news.
examples.zh: 公众对名人新闻似乎有着无法满足的胃口。

meanings: 难以理解、看透的，莫测的

examples.en: Her face had become inscrutable.
examples.zh: 她的脸变得让人捉摸不透。

examples.en: One particular author seems to be more insightful than the rest.
examples.zh: 其中一位作者似乎比其他人更有洞察力。

examples.en: She provides a clear and insightful account of the events.
examples.zh: 她对这些事件作出了清晰而深刻的叙述。

examples.en: The article insinuated that he was appointed because of family connections.
examples.zh: 这篇文章暗示，他是靠家族关系获得任命的。

examples.en: She insinuated her right hand under his arm.
examples.zh: 她悄悄地将右手伸到他的胳膊下面。

examples.en: She hid her worries behind an air of insouciance.
examples.zh: 她以漫不经心的样子掩饰自己的忧虑。

examples.en: The report highlights a number of instances of injustice.
examples.zh: 报告着重指出了一些不公正的实例。

examples.en: In most instances, there will be no need for further treatment.
examples.zh: 大多数情况下，无需进一步治疗。

examples.en: I refer to the situation instanced above.
examples.zh: 我指的是上文举例说明的情况。

examples.en: They were accused of instigating violence.
examples.zh: 他们被控煽动暴力。

examples.en: Those found guilty of instigating the unrest will be punished.
examples.zh: 被认定挑起骚乱的人将受到惩罚。

examples.en: The government has instigated a programme of economic reform.
examples.zh: 政府启动了一项经济改革计划。

examples.en: I acted purely on instinct.
examples.zh: 我完全是凭本能行动。

examples.en: I've always trusted my instincts in the past.
examples.zh: 过去我一直相信自己的直觉。

examples.en: Is he learning an instrument?
examples.zh: 他在学乐器吗？

examples.en: The law is not the best instrument for dealing with family matters.
examples.zh: 法律并不是处理家庭事务的最佳工具。

examples.en: The Act was amended by the passing of a statutory instrument.
examples.zh: 通过一项法定文书，对该法案作了修订。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: He was instrumental in bringing about an end to the conflict.
examples.zh: 他为结束冲突发挥了重要作用。

examples.en: The songs are largely instrumental.
examples.zh: 这些曲目大多是器乐曲。

examples.en: The British are often accused of being insular.
examples.zh: 英国人经常被指责思想封闭。

examples.en: She was really insulting to me.
examples.zh: 她对我非常无礼，带有侮辱性。

examples.en: He led an armed insurrection against the regime.
examples.zh: 他领导了一场反对该政权的武装起义。

examples.en: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
examples.zh: 所有学生都能轻松听懂他的讲课。

examples.en: The child’s speech was barely intelligible.
examples.zh: 这个孩子说的话几乎听不懂。

items.notes: 已读词典完整例句使用农业集约化专门义，未与当前加强、加剧义直接对应，故保持待补充。

examples.en: The princess was interred on an island in the middle of a lake.
examples.zh: 公主被安葬在湖心的一座岛上。

examples.en: ‘You're wrong,’ interjected Susan.
examples.zh: “你错了，”苏珊插话道。

examples.en: All talks have so far been conducted through an intermediary.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，所有会谈都通过中间人进行。

examples.en: Financial institutions act as intermediaries between lenders and borrowers.
examples.zh: 金融机构在借贷双方之间充当媒介。

examples.en: Mountains were seen as an intermediary realm between heaven and earth.
examples.zh: 群山被视为天地之间的中间领域。

examples.en: The drive seemed interminable.
examples.zh: 这段车程似乎没完没了。

examples.en: The problems are inextricably interwoven (= very closely connected).
examples.zh: 这些问题紧密交织，无法分开。

examples.en: The blue fabric was interwoven with red and gold thread.
examples.zh: 蓝色织物中交织着红线和金线。

examples.en: The old intimacy between them had gone for ever.
examples.zh: 他们往日的亲密已经一去不复返。

examples.en: He enjoys an intimacy with the president.
examples.zh: 他与总统关系密切。

examples.en: There was no intimation from his doctor that his condition was serious.
examples.zh: 他的医生没有暗示他的病情严重。

examples.en: The city intoxicated me with all its noise and life.
examples.zh: 这座城市的喧闹与活力令我陶醉。

examples.en: I’ve never mastered the intricacies of ballroom dancing.
examples.zh: 我从来没掌握交谊舞那些复杂的细节。

examples.en: It all sounds very intriguing.
examples.zh: 这一切听起来都十分引人入胜。

examples.en: These discoveries raise intriguing questions.
examples.zh: 这些发现提出了一些引人好奇的问题。

examples.en: These tasks were repetitive, lengthy and lacking any intrinsic interest.
examples.zh: 这些任务重复、冗长，本身毫无趣味。

examples.en: Small local shops are intrinsic to the town's character.
examples.zh: 当地的小商店是这个城镇特色的本质组成部分。

examples.en: You can’t always get to a real understanding of your own psychology through introspection alone.
examples.zh: 你不能总是仅靠内省就真正了解自己的心理。

examples.en: The sound of the telephone intruded into his dreams.
examples.zh: 电话声闯入了他的梦境。

examples.en: I'm sorry to intrude, but I need to talk to someone.
examples.zh: 抱歉打扰了，但我需要找人谈谈。

examples.en: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.
examples.zh: 他凭直觉知道读者想要什么。

examples.en: Flood waters inundate the river plain each spring.
examples.zh: 每到春天，洪水便淹没河流平原。

examples.en: She's inundated with work at the moment.
examples.zh: 她眼下被大量工作压得应接不暇。

meanings: 使习惯于（困难或不愉快之事）

examples.en: The prisoners quickly became inured to the harsh conditions.
examples.zh: 囚犯们很快就习惯了恶劣的条件。

examples.en: The book will be invaluable for students in higher education.
examples.zh: 这本书对高等院校的学生将极其有用。

examples.en: The research should prove invaluable in the study of children's language.
examples.zh: 这项研究应会对儿童语言研究大有帮助。

examples.en: Her routine was invariable.
examples.zh: 她的日常安排始终不变。

examples.en: This is an invariable law: true at all times and places.
examples.zh: 这是一条始终如一的规律，在任何时间和地点都成立。

examples.en: The gesture infuriated him and he let out a stream of invective.
examples.zh: 那个手势激怒了他，他破口大骂。

examples.en: Fax machines were a wonderful invention at the time.
examples.zh: 传真机在当时是一项了不起的发明。

examples.en: This story is apparently a complete invention.
examples.zh: 这个故事显然完全是虚构的。

examples.en: Her powers of invention were somewhat limited.
examples.zh: 她的创造能力有些有限。

examples.en: Union leaders called the new rules ‘invidious and divisive’.
examples.zh: 工会领导人称这些新规定“令人反感，而且制造分裂”。

examples.en: It would be invidious to single out any one person to thank.
examples.zh: 单独挑出某个人来感谢会招人不满。

examples.en: The water looks really inviting.
examples.zh: 这水看起来真诱人。

examples.en: The house, with its boarded-up windows, was hardly inviting.
examples.zh: 这座房子的窗户都用木板封着，实在不让人想进去。

examples.en: It is unlikely that libel laws will be invoked.
examples.zh: 诽谤法不太可能被援引。

examples.en: This command will invoke the HELP system.
examples.zh: 这个命令将调用帮助系统。

examples.en: The complete calculation is too involved to include here.
examples.zh: 完整的计算过程过于复杂，无法在此列出。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: Several people have been involved with the project from the beginning.
examples.zh: 有几个人从一开始就参与了这个项目。

examples.en: How many vehicles were involved in the crash?
examples.zh: 这起事故涉及多少辆车？

examples.en: That evidence is irrelevant to the case.
examples.zh: 那份证据与此案无关。

examples.en: Some of the discussion appears irrelevant to the topic in hand.
examples.zh: 其中一些讨论似乎与眼下的主题无关。

source.publisher: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary of Academic English

examples.en: Her death is an irreparable loss.
examples.zh: 她的去世是无法弥补的损失。

meanings: 无可指责的，无可非议的

examples.en: I felt an irresistible urge to laugh.
examples.zh: 我感到一阵无法抑制的笑意。

examples.en: The bright colours were irresistible to the baby.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的颜色让婴儿无法抗拒。

examples.en: The way she puts on that accent really irritates me.
examples.zh: 她装出那种口音的样子真让我烦躁。

examples.en: Some drugs can irritate the lining of the stomach.
examples.zh: 某些药物会刺激胃黏膜。

examples.en: It was a meal to tempt even the most jaded palate.
examples.zh: 这顿饭足以吸引口味最厌倦的人。

examples.en: I felt terribly jaded after working all weekend.
examples.zh: 整个周末都在工作后，我感到疲惫不堪。

examples.en: Try to avoid using too much technical jargon.
examples.zh: 尽量避免使用太多专业术语。

examples.en: He would never do anything to jeopardize his career.
examples.zh: 他绝不会做任何危及自己事业的事。

examples.en: He laughed uproariously at his own jest.
examples.zh: 他被自己的玩笑逗得放声大笑。

examples.en: Would I jest about such a thing?
examples.zh: 我会拿这样的事开玩笑吗？

examples.en: Your statement doesn't jibe with the facts.
examples.zh: 你的说法与事实不吻合。

examples.en: He jibed repeatedly at the errors they had made.
examples.zh: 他一再嘲讽他们犯下的错误。

examples.en: He made several cheap jibes at his opponent during the interview.
examples.zh: 采访期间，他数次用低劣的言辞挖苦对手。

examples.en: The bands are constantly jockeying with each other for the number one spot.
examples.zh: 这些乐队不断相互争夺排行榜第一的位置。

examples.en: Which jockey will be riding tomorrow?
examples.zh: 明天由哪位骑师出赛？

examples.en: There are two joysticks on the console, which you operate with your thumbs.
examples.zh: 控制台上有两个操纵杆，用拇指操作。

examples.en: The fans were in jubilant mood after the victory.
examples.zh: 获胜后，球迷们欢欣鼓舞。

examples.en: The fans were in jubilant mood after the victory.
examples.zh: 获胜后，球迷们喜气洋洋。

examples.en: There were scenes of jubilation among her supporters.
examples.zh: 她的支持者们呈现出一片欣喜若狂的景象。

examples.en: Greenpeace applied for a judicial review to challenge the court’s decision.
examples.zh: 绿色和平组织申请司法复核，以质疑法院的裁决。

examples.en: The Supreme Court ordered a judicial inquiry into the deaths.
examples.zh: 最高法院下令对这些死亡事件进行司法调查。

meanings: 判断明智的，审慎合理的

examples.en: It is curable with judicious use of antibiotics.
examples.zh: 合理使用抗生素可以治愈它。

examples.en: What can be done to help these juvenile delinquents turn away from crime?
examples.zh: 怎样才能帮助这些少年犯远离犯罪？

examples.en: Don't be so juvenile!
examples.zh: 别这么幼稚！

examples.en: Most of the suspects were juveniles under the age of 17.
examples.zh: 大多数嫌疑人都是十七岁以下的未成年人。

meanings: 把不同事物并置、并列（以便比较或形成对照）

examples.en: In the exhibition, abstract paintings are juxtaposed with shocking photographs.
examples.zh: 展览中，抽象画与令人震惊的照片并置展出。

examples.en: It is a traditional society in which the kinship group is very important.
examples.zh: 这是一个亲属群体非常重要的传统社会。

examples.en: We tend to feel kinship with those who share the same values.
examples.zh: 我们往往对价值观相同的人产生亲近感。

examples.en: Checking all the information will be slow and laborious.
examples.zh: 核查所有信息将是缓慢而费力的工作。

examples.en: We lost our way in the labyrinth of streets.
examples.zh: 我们在迷宫般的街道中迷路了。

examples.en: She was pink-eyed and lachrymose.
examples.zh: 她眼圈发红，泪汪汪的。

examples.en: The film is a lachrymose melodrama.
examples.zh: 这部电影是一出催泪的情节剧。

examples.en: The conditioner will revitalize lacklustre hair.
examples.zh: 这种护发素会让暗淡无光的头发恢复光泽。

examples.en: There were signs of discontent at the party's lacklustre performance.
examples.zh: 人们已对该党平庸乏味的表现显出不满。

meanings: 言简意赅的，寥寥数语的

examples.en: In many parishes the laity now takes/take a more active role than in the past.
examples.zh: 如今在许多教区，普通信徒发挥的作用比过去更加积极。

examples.en: She sat alone weeping, lamenting her fate.
examples.zh: 她独自坐着哭泣，悲叹自己的命运。

examples.en: In the poem, he laments the destruction of the countryside.
examples.zh: 他在诗中对乡村遭到破坏深感遗憾。

examples.en: She shows a lamentable lack of understanding.
examples.zh: 她表现出令人遗憾的理解力不足。

examples.en: Share prices languished at the closing bell.
examples.zh: 收盘时股价依然低迷。

examples.en: She continues to languish in a foreign prison.
examples.zh: 她继续在异国监狱里煎熬。

examples.en: The share price languished at 102p.
examples.zh: 股价停滞在一百零二便士。

examples.en: A momentary lapse in the final set cost her the match.
examples.zh: 最后一盘中一时的失误使她输掉了比赛。

examples.en: After a lapse of six months we met up again.
examples.zh: 相隔六个月，我们又见面了。

examples.en: The treaty lapsed in 1995.
examples.zh: 该条约于一九九五年失效。

examples.en: She lapsed into silence again.
examples.zh: 她又陷入了沉默。

examples.en: She is not noted for her largesse (= she is not generous).
examples.zh: 她并不以慷慨著称。

examples.en: She underwent a heart transplant in a last-ditch attempt to save her.
examples.zh: 为了救她，医生作出最后一搏，给她进行了心脏移植。

examples.en: She underwent a heart transplant in a last-ditch attempt to save her.
examples.zh: 她接受了心脏移植，作为挽救生命的最后一搏。

examples.en: These children have a huge reserve of latent talent.
examples.zh: 这些孩子蕴藏着巨大的潜在天赋。

examples.en: In winter, prune back laterals.
examples.zh: 冬天要把侧枝修剪短。

examples.en: Pryor threw a lateral to Palmer.
examples.zh: 普赖尔向帕尔默作了一次侧后传球。

examples.en: It was one of the most lavish weddings I’ve ever been to.
examples.zh: 这是我参加过的最奢华的婚礼之一。

examples.en: He was lavish in his praise for her paintings.
examples.zh: 他对她的画作赞不绝口。

examples.en: She lavishes most of her attention on her youngest son.
examples.zh: 她把大部分注意力都倾注在小儿子身上。

examples.en: We want to make statistics easier for the layperson to grasp.
examples.zh: 我们想让统计学更容易被外行理解。

examples.en: Nitrates leach from the soil into rivers.
examples.zh: 硝酸盐从土壤中浸出，进入河流。

examples.en: The nutrient is quickly leached away.
examples.zh: 这种营养物质很快就被淋滤带走了。

examples.en: All dogs must be kept on a leash in public places.
examples.zh: 在公共场所，所有狗都必须拴上牵引绳。

examples.en: A few jokes add leaven to a boring speech.
examples.zh: 几个笑话给枯燥的演讲增添了活力。

meanings: 使活泼、轻松或有所改变

examples.en: Her speech was leavened with a touch of humour.
examples.zh: 她的讲话中掺入了一点幽默，显得轻松起来。

examples.en: How much leeway should parents give their children?
examples.zh: 父母应该给孩子多大自由？

examples.en: When it came to the vote, Democrat legislators split 115:150 against the motion.
examples.zh: 表决时，民主党议员中一百一十五人赞成、一百五十人反对该动议。

examples.en: Seven of the state’s 90 legislators have been indicted.
examples.zh: 该州九十名议员中有七人已被起诉。
